_comment: Per-component line-coverage floors, in percent. Read by
ADVISORY ONLY. A component below its floor is reported as BELOW and
explained in the summary, but the run still exits 0 -- nothing here can fail
a build today. `--enforce` turns a breach into a non-zero exit, and no make
target passes it yet; adding it to one is the single change that flips this
from reporting to gating, once the numbers are trusted enough to gate on.
Each floor is the measured figure on 2026-09-22 rounded down to a whole
percent, which leaves under a point of headroom. They are set to catch a
regression, not to demand improvement -- so when a component rises, raise its
floor rather than banking the slack. The report says so when it notices.
The three Node figures are optimistic: their tools report only files a test
loaded, so files nothing imports are excluded from the percentage rather than
counted as zero. Compare like with like when moving them.
